pages.name: Gold Bookskito
pages.text: Bound in gold, and shimmering like an enchanted book.

One bookskito in a hundred is bound in gold. It lives like its cousins, perching on bookshelves and resting on the floor, and it will not bite anyone wearing gold.$(br2)It also does something none of them can: it learns.

$(item)Learning$()$(br)Offer a gold bookskito an enchanted book and it takes in the enchantments written inside. A new one is taken unless it clashes with one it already holds.$(br2)Of two levels of the same enchantment the higher wins, and two equal levels make one level more, up to the most it allows.
An enchantment that teaches it nothing is lost with the book, and a book with nothing to teach is left alone.$(br2)There is no end to how many different enchantments it can hold.

$(item)As armor$()$(br)Armor enchantments protect it as if it wore a single piece: protection, feather falling, thorns, even respiration under water.$(br2)$(item)As a weapon$()$(br)Its bite takes on the weapon enchantments: sharpness, smite, fire aspect, knockback.

$(item)Mending$()$(br)A hurt bookskito that holds mending mends itself on the experience orbs it catches.$(br2)$(item)Glyphs$()$(br)Enchanting glyphs drift in its wake as it flies. The more enchantments it holds, the thicker they come.
